dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder (conversion disorder) presenting as apparent coma with paralysis, mutism and total anaesthesia, in a patient with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes and stage 3b–4 chronic kidney disease.

Alternatives to consider:
1. Catatonia (recurrent unresponsiveness and mutism, even in absence of psychiatric history)
2. Dissociative stupor / non-epileptic attack disorder
3. Hyperosmolar hyperglycaemic state or uraemic encephalopathy precipitating functional overlay
